P4A.title: Benchmark integrity hardening (IJ-SDK-1.1 P4A) - checkpoint 1
notes: CHECKPOINT 1, stopped by the operator. The gate is NOT_RUN: D01-D03 are untouched and no red-vs-audited evidence exists yet for the regression suite.

Repaired in code: D04 (complete per-trial reset, epoch abort, usage returned as a copy); D05 (reservation budget controller: attempts counted at start, remaining budget per request, absolute monotonic deadline, failed calls charged, tool deadline, bounded corrective retries); D06 (tool exists -> schema -> authorize -> preconditions/approval -> idempotency -> fault -> transaction -> audit; a fault can no longer grant permission; handler runs on a transactional draft with rollback); D07 event-log half (decoded response and token ids are different stages, event and parent ids, resume-safe sequence, hash chain, seal).

Verified how: 93 stdlib-unittest tests in tests/ij_sdk pass on this Windows workstation with unittest. NOT yet verified: under pytest, on Linux, or in CI; and not yet run against the audited commit to record red.
Same 76 probes, current tree vs audited commit: reproduced 46 vs 75. D04 5->0, D05 13->3, D06 13->3, D07 13->9, D01 6->6, D02 16->16, D03 9->9.

Of the 46 still reproduced: 36 are work not started (D01-D03 oracle = 31; D07 evidence validator = D07.08-D07.12 = 5); 5 probes correspond to 3 small real gaps (D07.04/D07.05/D07.06: the adapter emits and declares no tool-stage events when the handler is a plain callable; D05.12: no adapter-level cancel(); D06.12: no explicit gateway begin/commit/rollback scope); 5 are probe criteria that need correcting while unit tests already cover the behaviour (D05.03 field name, D05.13, D06.09, D07.13) or that must be adapted to the transaction API (D06.10, whose legacy closure-mutating handler the gateway now flags as non-transactional).
